bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
tag=create-videobot:menu-recovery-4decbe6
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/menu-recovery-4decbe6-20261125"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
docker inspect "$cid" --format 'state={{.State.Status}} restarts={{.RestartCount}} image={{.Image}} started={{.State.StartedAt}}'
docker exec -i -w /opt/videobot "$cid" sh -c 'while IFS= read -r f;do sha256sum "$f" || exit 1;done' < "$stage/runtime-files.txt" > "$stage/readback.sha"
diff -u "$stage/expected.sha" "$stage/readback.sha"
echo RUNTIME_CODE_MATCHES_TESTED_HEAD
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'console.log("TERMS_CONFIGURED="+Boolean(process.env.CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL));console.log("TERMS_CANONICAL="+(process.env.CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL==="https://tgtumbler-docs.pages.dev/createvdobot-terms.html"));console.log("INVOICE_MODE="+(process.env.VIDEO_SALE_MODE==="invoice"))'
docker logs --tail 80 "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -E 'READY=|CREATOR_DM_UPDATES_HANDLED=|CREATOR_UPDATES_QUARANTINED=|CREATOR_PUBLISHED_TERMS_URL_REQUIRED|Error:' || true
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_STATE
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
# Only examine the existing resident test interface, never session contents.
gate="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
if test -d "$gate/scripts";then find "$gate/scripts" -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*userbot*' -printf '%f\n';fi
echo USERBOT_SOCKET_CANDIDATES
if test -d "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}";then find "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}" -maxdepth 2 -type s -iname '*userbot*' -printf '%f\n';fi
echo INDEPENDENT_RUNTIME_READBACK_PASS
set -eu
target=req_202611250625b11c00000007
root=
for p in /home/gace/Project/server-core /home/gace/Project/Gserver/server-core /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository /home/gace/server-core /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/server-core; do
 if test -f "$p/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py"; then root="$p"; break; fi
done
if test -z "$root"; then
 script="$(find /home/gace/Project -maxdepth 7 -type f -name servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py -print -quit 2>/dev/null)"
 if test -n "$script"; then root="${script%/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py}"; fi
fi
test -n "$root" || exit 61
cd "$root"
python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py "$target" --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
